title: Fix Session Json Format
description: Update session.json format from {uuid, client, llm, started_at, transcript, first_event} to {id, uri, contributor, client, second, transcript}. Update SessionMeta struct, writeSessionMeta, logHook construction, ExtractSessionSecond, and related tests.
